batting.dismissal: st AC Gilchrist b PP Ojha

batting.name: SS Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c RJ Harris b PP Ojha

batting.name: KA Pollard
batting.dismissal: c A Symonds b RJ Harris

batting.name: HH Gibbs
batting.dismissal: c SR Tendulkar b Z Khan

batting.name: MD Mishra
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b KA Pollard

batting.name: TL Suman
batting.dismissal: c AT Rayudu b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: RJ Harris
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b R McLaren

batting.name: R Sharma
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b Harbhajan Singh

balls.text: Symonds takes a good running catch, short on the off, pulled high but into the palms of Symonds running to his right from long-on
Pollard's doing well here, full toss outside off, makes room and slices it over point and it rolls over the ropes
two more, slower one and he mistimes a pull, the fielder has to run to his left, collects but Pollard rushes back quickly to finish the second
he's mowed that through midwicket, a length ball on middle, made room and crashed it for a boundary, all bottom hand
short, mistimes a pull towards deep square leg, rushes back to the second
full outside off, driven wide of long-off for a couple of runs
dropped, admittedly, a difficult chance, pulled away over square leg, Rohit runs across and dives but can't quite hold on to that powerfully struck shot, however he keeps them to a couple
Rayudu is turning it on, short of a length, he gets to his half-century in style, stepping out of the crease, making room and clattering that over the deep extra cover boundary for six
Poor stuff from Jaskaran, driven to deep cover and Jaskaran fails to collect the throw, fumbles and allows them two more
Jaskaran feeling the nerves, slower one but too wide, given by the umpire
four more, short delivery, Gilchrist won't be happy, walks across and pulls it high over square leg for a couple of bounces over the ropes
full toss on middle, Rayudu's been excellent finding the gaps, this time he smacks it over the bowler's head to beat the converging long-on and long-off
length ball on middle, smashed down the ground but straight to long-on
fullish on the pads, swipes it towards deep midwicket, Pollard urges him to come back for the second, does so just in time, the umpire calls for a replay but the dive saves him
short on the off, slapped off the back foot on the bounce to extra cover, no run there
full on middle and leg, driven down to long-on, came off the middle
aiming for the yorker, makes room and works it to deep square leg for a single
fullish on the off, driven down to deep midwicket for a single
powerfully hit, that's what Mumbai expect from him, short on middle and he bludgeons it through square leg for a boundary

smart batting from Rayudu, fine leg is inside the circle, that was tossed up on leg stump and he swept it fine to fetch four more, a disappointing end to what was for the most part an excellent spell by Ojha
Rayudu picks the gap superbly, short on middle and he pulls it between deep square leg and deep midwicket for a four, not much power involved, but excellent placement

had shaped up for a reverse-sweep but then changed his mind, slightly short on middle and he targeted the leg side, swept it well over square leg but Ryan Harris in the deep covered good ground moving to his left, juggled and held on to a good running catch
pushes it back to Ojha who fumbles moving to his right and concedes a single
short of a good length on the off, steps out of the crease and drops it on the off side
driven straight back to the bowler, is struck on the ankle and it ricochets towards long-on for a single
picked the offspinner, tossed it up, comes down the track, gets to the pitch and dispatches it miles over deep square leg, powerfully struck
the offspinner, full on middle, flicked through midwicket for a single
slower one bowled short on the off, cuts it to point
short, pulls it away but just a single as it lands on the bounce to deep midwicket
short of a length, cut away to deep point for a single
short of a good length, makes room and slaps it past extra cover into the deep for a well-taken couple
sweeps it hard, over square leg, but Rohit, running to his right, does superbly, punching the ball back in and keeping them down to just one
well struck, bowled it flat but he had made up his mind, stepped out, took it on the half-volley and sent it over long-on for a big one
flighted on leg stump, Rayudu steps out and drives that down to long-on
pushes it wide of midwicket from the crease for a single
short of a length on the off, punched back to the bowler
shortish outside leg, turning in, tried to whip it square, struck on the pads, steals a quick leg bye
crashed through the off side  but there's cover in the deep, long-off runs across and restricts them to a couple
well bowled, quicker delivery and he was late in playing that cut, zipped past the outside edge
dropped again, Monish Mishra the culprit, he's standing at point, comes down the track and slices that full toss straight to him, wasn't expecting it and spills it turning to his left, two lapses
doesn't that happen so often, no trouble dismissing that into the stands, full outside off and he slog-sweeps that over deep midwicket, powerful strike
dropped and six, came down the track and swing it in the direction of wide long-on where Gibbs timed his jump well but ended up palming off over the ropes, was a few yards inside the ropes
short of a length, turning in, dabs it towards point
turning in from a good length outside off, pushed back to the bowler
slips that in quicker, turned away wide of square leg for one more
flighted on the off, comes down the track and drives it through midwicket, wristily done, for two more
staying on the pads, swept it really fine, Ojha covers good ground to keep them down to a couple
comes down the track, digs it out through midwicket into the deep for a single
short of a length, cuts it down to point
back to medium pace, short on middle, jabs it to deep midwicket to keep the strike
chopped it in front of point and races off for one more
a bit of air this time, gets forward and knocks it past Symonds to long-on for a single
sticking to spin given the track is turning, drops it in front of point for a single
the offspinner, turns away to beat the outside edge as he gets forward to defend
shortish from Symonds, chipped it wide of him for a single
short on the off, punched wide of midwicket for a single
full toss on the off, had picked his spot there and executed the shot to perfection, opened the face ever so slightly and drove it through extra cover to beat the fielder's dive and find the boundary
flighted on middle, tickled through midwicket, one more
drilled down the ground towards Symonds at long-on for a single
round the wicket, appeared to just outside leg stump, turns in and strikes him on the pads as he tries to sweep, a leg bye taken
shortish outside off, cut towards point, races through for a single
quicker one, short on the off and skidded on, chopped it just at the right time in front of point
quicker delivery, pitched it on a length, driven with a full face to deep cover
three full tosses in a row and Rayudu doesn't let go of the opportunity this time, swats it through midwicket, beats long-on and deep midwicket
low full toss on the off, struck down to long-off for one more
full toss on the off, punched down to long-on for a single
bowls it on a good length on the off, gets a big stride forward and defends to cover

Ojha's the man, after turning the previous two away he sends in the one with the arm which Bravo fails to pick, is beaten through the gate and it crashes into the stumps, three down and Deccan are ahead now
ooh, turns away as he closes the face and it strikes the outside half of the bat, Bravo is not looking too convincing here

appeal for lbw, close call, lands on a good length on middle and was turning away but not an awful lot, struck on the pads as he plays inside the line, big appeal but we're not sure if that would have missed off
quicker through the air and flat, tries to sweep it through square leg,. doesn't quite get hold, just the single
short and wide and Tiwary senses a chance, cuts it through the vacant point region to earn a welcome boundary
sliding on leg stump from round wicket, pushed in front of midwicket for a single
tossed up on middle, tickled wide of midwicket to get off the mark, the spinners have dragged this back
low full toss on the off, driven straight to extra cover
gives it plenty of air this time, gets forward and defends it to cover
short of a good length on leg stump, goes on straight again, tries to whip it through square, struck high on the pads

gone, that one didn't turn, shortish on middle, Tendulkar shuffled across to work it behind square, missed and was struck in line, struck on the knee role but replays indicate that would have gone on, the umpire raises his finger and Rahul can't control himself, what a blow
starts with a log hop that Tiwary mistimes, tries to pull it over midwicket but doesn't get the elevation, just evades the fielder, just the single
the frustration was setting in and out comes the slog-sweep, well struck but Symonds does well to haul it in in the deep and keeps them down to just one
what an over, gets on the back foot and drops it in front of point
lovely bowling, induced him to come out of the crease and got it to turn a bit extra, defended back to the bowler
turning in, shorter, tries to chop it behind point, misses
gets forward and defends that watchfully, as it turns in

stumped, gets a wicket first ball, tosses it up outside off, Dhawan comes down the track, turns in but Dhawan was expecting more, defended inside the line, missed and Gilly made no mistake this time, one down
two more, well run, flighted on middle, plays it in identical fashion but much closer to deep midwicket, Dhawan, however, is quick on his feet and gets back to complete the second in time
raises the 50-stand with a drive through midwicket, a couple more in the deep
flights it on the off, gets forward and drives it towards mid-on, no run there
the offspinner again, turns in to rap him on the pads as he tries to work it away, struck outside the line
the offspinner, flighted on the off, lofted into the deep in front of deep midwicket for a couple of runs
dropped, oh Gilly, shortish, Tendulkar made room to crack it over extra cover, got a thick edge but Gilly couldn't hold on, sharp chance but we'll see if it proves costly
short of a good length, moving away a hint, Tendulkar walks forward, punches it in front of mid-off and sets off
good length this time, crunched wide of mid-off for a quick single
bowls it on a good length on the off, tries to force it through the on-side, plays it straight to mid-on
one point has been pushed back, short and wide again, cracked into the deep for a single
short and wide, he picked the gap perfectly, had ample time to position himself and bisected that gap between the two points for a boundary
starts with a full toss which isn't dismissed, pushed to mid-off for a single
overpitched but he can't pierce the gap, closes the face slightly and drives it to mid-on
knocked down in front of point, no chance of a single there
moral victory for the bowler, found some late movement this time which produced a leading edge as Tendulkar tried to turn the face, there's no slip in place and it races to the third-man boundary
shot, typical Tendulkar, that straight drive again, how many times have we seen it, full on middle and he shows the full face of the blade while drilling it down the ground
full toss on middle and leg, whipped away through square, fine leg runs across and keeps them down to a couple
short of a good length on the off, drops it in front of cover for a quick single, Symonds fumbled as they were sneaking through
back to seam-ups, short on the off, punched off the back foot to mid-off, one more
slips in the offspinner, flighted on the off, Dhawan has time to bend low and sweep that firmly past a diving square leg to the ropes
tight line, just on and around off stump, gets forward and eases it wide of mid-off for a single
shortish on middle, mistimes a pull wide of midwicket for a single
angling in towards off, turns the face and tap it wide of square leg for a single
shortish on the off, slapped off the back foot through mid-off for a single
well kept by Gilly, short and down the leg side, a horrendous start but Gilly does well, stretching to his right and saving some runs
pushed it full on the off, charges down the track and drives it neatly but straight to mid-off
shortish on the off, gets back and gets a thickish edge towards point
crisply driven, not pitched up but just about lands on a length, Sachin gets forward and drives it through the covers for a boundary
slightly short on the off, appears to hold its line, opens the face and guides it to point
short of a good length on the off, drops it just in front of the bowler and races off for a single
shortish on middle, flicked away towards deep square leg for a single

comes on to him really slowly, tries to sweep it behind square, is struck on the pads, a direct-hit at the non-striker's end as Sachin tries to get back, Rohit appeals but there's no response from the umpire
mis-field by Gibbs, shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and punches it to Gibbs at extra cover who  gets a bit of a bad bounce and concedes a couple
flighted on middle and leg, gets forward and sweeps it hard on the bounce to deep square leg, just the single
Sachin frees his arms, flighted on middle from round the wicket, he stretches forward and chips it over mid-on for a one bounce four, cleanly struck
shortish on leg stump, tickles it in front of square leg, a quick single taken
short of a good length on middle, worked away off the back foot wide of square leg, he's away
another one, flighted this time but down leg again, Gilchrist fumbles behind the stumps and they sneak a run
coming round the wicket, slides it well down the leg side, given a wide
misses a full toss, straight on leg stump and Ojha, beaten by the pace, can't get his bat to it, timber!
full toss on the off, steered to it point, Pollard returns a strong throw that is not backed up, a couple to the score
on middle and off, defended watchfully to the bowler
flighted on middle, pushed to midwicket
tries an identical shot but the doosra does him in, it turns away, he gets the leading edge and Rayudu, running to his right, snaps a well-judged catch
short on middle, gets some extra bounce as he tries to pull through midwicket, gets a thick edge in front of point
Rahul's gone, lands on middle, heaves it straight to Bravo at deep backward square leg, a hopeless situation for Deccan now
slower one this time, flicked through square leg for a single
full and down the leg side, given a wide
full on middle, square-driven through point into the deep for a single
misses again, quick this time, makes room to swing that over the on-side, gets to Rayudu on the bounce and he does well to get his body behind it
deceived by the slower one, fullish and moves away as he makes way to play that through the off side, misses
full on the off, driven straight to mid-off where Harbhajan picks and aims accurately but the batsman is back in time
full on middle, almost a yorker, pushed past midwicket for a single
short and that's dismissed with utter contempt, shovelled between deep square leg and deep midwicket for a boundary
makes room and the bowler chases him, defended back to the McLaren
low full toss on the off, pushed wide of extra cover for a single
stylish flick but straight in the hands of Dhawan at deep square leg, fullish on middle and leg and it's nicely picked up but he found the fielder
nicely struck, long time coming, fullish on the off, moves away and blasts it through extra cover for a boundary
angling towards leg stump, tries to whip it fine, is struck on the pads, they get a leg bye
slower one bowled short, drags it towards deep square leg, a good return to the keeper but Harris has scampered back for the second
slower one bowled full outside off, swung away towards McLaren at deep square leg, just the single again
full outside off, driven straight to extra cover, just the single
change of pace again, heaves it in the direction of square leg, gets to him on the bounce
ohhh, just fell short of the bowler, a slower one that, bowled short on the off, chipped it back towards the bowler, Pollard dived forward and to his right but couldn't get to it
bowled it short on middle, pulled away behind square, McLaren, who's just completed an over, runs yards to his right, dives and pulls it back in, just two
low full toss on middle, pushed through to long-on, they contemplate a second but that's where it stays
targeting the blockhole, just outside off, and he fails to get his bat down in time
the legcutter there, bowled at 112.8 kmph, fails to pick it, pushes through the line, gets a thick edge to third man
slower one bowled full, gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single
short on the off, good bounce, moves away and slashes that down to third man for a single
short of a good length on middle,. punched to long-on for a single
slower one bowled short on the off, pushed towards long-on, gently, for a couple
slower one bowled on a good length on middle, missing leg as he tries to play that into the leg side, struck on the pads
full toss on the off, pushed to extra cover
Bowled Pollard caught Bravo, full on the off, lofts it straight down to Bravo at long-on, was reasonably well struck but not well enough, the West Indians combine to hand Mumbai another wicket
slower one, T Suman wants to send it into the stands, doesn't pick the slower one, has a big heave, misses
short on the off, pulled away to deep square leg for a single
bangs it short on middle, fends it away into the leg side for a single
bowled'im! Is that the game? Short on the off, Symonds makes room to cut, misses and the ball chops the top of middle and off, big wicket, perhaps the decisive blow, Deccan are in trouble
slower one there, makes room and swats it in front of long-on for a couple
full toss on middle, pushed past the bowler, just wide of long-off, for a well-taken two
short of a good length, punches it from the crease in the direction of deep point
McLaren bowls it on a length outside off, crashed all along the ground to deep cover
Symonds misses and Rayudu continues to impress behind the stumps as he dives full stretch to his left to concede just a bye
bowls it from way wide of the crease, and it's called a no-ball, his back foot is wide of the crease as he delivers, freehit time
short and wide again, comes down the track and cracks it wide of deep point for a couple of runs
bowls it from wide of the crease, slashed away to deep point for a single
slower one bowled short on the off, drops it in front of square leg for a single
slower one bowled on the off, defended towards midwicket

superb catch, brilliant reactions from Pollard on his follow through, lands on a good length and Rohit pushes through the line, times it well, firmly struck, but Pollard bends low and snaps it with both hands, Deccan slip further
through him this time, full and he tries to drive that hard through extra cover, can't connect
pushes it fuller outside off, makes room and thinks its wide but its not
short again, the cut shot was on but he ends up getting an inside edge on the bounce to the keeper
short and wide, cut hard and Pollard has no chance this time, third man stretches and dives to his right, Zaheer it is, but can't haul it back in
runs it down towards third man for a single
short outside off, cut away through Pollard, who mis-fields, to allow them to take two where there should have been just one
comes from wide of the crease, slaps it towards deep midwicket for a couple of runs, steadily progressing are these two
full toss on middle, flicked down to deep square leg for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, dabbed to short third for a single
bouncer, and Rayudu does brilliantly moving to his left, snaps it with his left glove but is in pain after sustaining an injury earlier in the game, he's getting some attention now, called a wide
well fielded by R Sathish at deep square leg, pulled away hard and he dives to his left to keep them down to just a single
shortish on the off, opens the face to guide it down to third man
slower one bowled short outside off, comes down the track to tap it into the off side, gets an inside edge just wide of the stumps for a single
slips it down the leg side, Rohit tries to help that down, misses, given a wide
short outside off, bunts it down towards long-on for a single
short outside off, cut down towards Pollard who dives to his right to prevent any run
slower one bowled short outside off, hangs his bat out, gets an inside edge and Rayudu does well moving to his left
short of a length outside off, cut away just wide of third man for a couple of runs
slower one bowled full, 107 kmph, driven hard towards long-off for a single
sliding on the pads and is dealt with, flicked away wide of short fine for a boundary
full on the off, driven down towards long-off for a single
uses his wrists to turn that through square leg for a single
shortish on leg stump, dabs it in front of square leg, a single taken
shortish outside off, cracked towards deep point for a single
lands on a good length on leg stump, defended back to the bowler
bowled'im! Gilchrist swings and misses, Zaheer aims accurately, full on middle, Gilchrist has his eyes set on midwicket, can't connect and the stumps take a hammering!
slower one bowled short on the off, cut down to short third man

run-out, pushed away towards square leg, they scampered for a single but there was plenty of hesitation as they tried to decide on the second, Laxman took off, Harris sent him back, an accurate throw to the keeper as Gilchrist makes way, Rayudu takes off the bails and Laxman is a long way out
full on middle, driven down to long-on for a single
tries to force that length delivery through the off side, mistimes it back to the bowler
pitched it up on the off, cracked it back to the bowler
starts off with a slower one, worked wide of midwicket for a couple of runs
full and outside off, easy for Gilchrist, driven beautifully past extra cover for four
on the pads, Laxman turns it to short fine leg and takes a single to get off the mark
guided towards backward point this time, bit of confusion on whether to go for the run, decide against it finally
pitched up on middle, Laxman whips it towards mid-on, straight at the fielder though
angling into the pads, clipped behind square leg by Gilchrist
gets a wicket first ball, Gibbs comes down the track and looks to swipe the ball, nowhere near the pitch of the ball, gets a top-edge that loops to Tendulkar at extra cover
another misfield, no bad bounce this time though, Zaheer can't latch on to a nicely timed off drive from Gilchrist off a low full toss from Malinga
another length ball from Malinga, Gibbs mishits as he tries to heave the ball over the leg side, lands just outside the circle behind midwicket
another full one, Gilchrist drives crisply towards point, Sathish gets a bad bounce so can't collect cleanly
keeps it full, on middle and off, Gilchrist punches towards mid-off, too firmly to take a single
fuller and wide, Gilchrist swings again but doesn't connect
a rarity from Malinga - length ball - Gilchrist swings it cleanly, high and over long-on for six
full toss on the pads, Pollard does well in the deep, Gibbs turns it away through square leg and he runs across to kick that back in and ensure they take just a couple
full on middle, pushed wide of midwicket for a single
short of a length outside off, late-cuts it just wide of point where Malinga dives to keep them down to a couple
knocked it past the bowler for a single in front of mid-on
round the wicket, full on the off, pushed towards extra cover
induced him to step out of the crease, Gilchrist got to the pitch and chipped it towards mid-off, grimaces in pain there
lands on a good length on middle, pushes it gently to mid-on
yorker on middle this time, 138 kmph, Gibbs does well to keep his feet out of the way and dig it out towards cover
slower one bowled full outside off, 118 kmph, dug out towards point
pitched up on the off and Gibbs connects well, driving it uppishly wide of mid-off for a boundary
fullish on middle, that would have been close had Tendulkar picked that up at midwicket, Gilchrist was halfway down the pitch before being sent back but Tendulkar will rue the fumble
full outside off, defended towards point
whipped away to square leg, no single on offer there
appeal for lbw, went straight on pitched on middle and leg and didn't turn, struck him on the pads as he came forward to defend, it could have missed leg
short on middle, pushed off the back foot through midwicket for a single
four more, flighted on middle, gets forward and just chips it effortlessly over mid-on, good start for Deccan
crunched through cover, tossed up outside off, eases it off the front foot, through the in-field for a boundary
flighted on the off, pushed it to extra cover
